effect_description_eng:
[On Play] You may play 1 [Labramon] or [Seasarmon] from your hand or from one of your Digimon's digivolution cards without paying the cost.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon is played from digivolution cards, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of your blue Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn. (This Digimon can attack the turn it comes into play.)
